headline: Post-IPO momentum
detail: Fourth session after the Dec 10 IPO ($68 priced; opened $146). Vaccine-reopening bid for travel names; no company news.

headline: Tigress Financial initiates Buy
detail: Quiet period over; first wave of ~25 initiations. Tigress called ABNB a category maker.

headline: Analyst-initiation and reopening momentum
detail: No single item found; part of a +25% January driven by new coverage and pent-up-demand narrative. Peers fell the same day.

headline: Momentum into Feb 11 all-time high ($216.84)
detail: Stock nearly tripled from IPO in two months; peers flat to down.

headline: Rates spike hits growth
detail: 10-yr yield jumped to 1.5%; Nasdaq -3.5%. Day of Q4'20 print after the close.

headline: Q4'20 (first print as a public company)
detail: Revenue $859M (-22% YoY) beat ~$748M est; nights 46.3M (-39%); GBV $5.9B (-31%); ADR $128 (+13%); net loss $3.9B on IPO charges. Bookings recovery narrative.

headline: Growth rebound after rates scare
detail: Nasdaq +2.3%; $1.9T stimulus signed. No company news.

headline: Afghan refugee housing pledge; DA Davidson reiterates Buy
detail: Airbnb offered free housing to 20k refugees; analyst said Q3 on track for record revenue. Pfizer full FDA approval (Aug 23) lifted travel.

headline: Q3'21 record quarter (Expedia also reported)
detail: Revenue $2.24B (+67% YoY; +36% vs 2019); nights 79.7M (+29%); GBV $11.9B (+48%); net income $834M; adj EBITDA $1.1B (49% margin). Expedia +15.6% same day on its own beat.

headline: Post-earnings momentum
detail: No company-specific catalyst found; stock re-tested $200 a week after the Q3 print.

headline: Growth rotation on Powell renomination
detail: Yields rose; long-duration growth sold. Omicron news came four days later (Nov 26).

headline: Omicron-is-milder relief rally
detail: Travel names rebounded after a week of Omicron selling; BKNG +5%, EXPE +7%.

headline: Month-end growth rebound
detail: Nasdaq +3.2% after worst January since 2008. No company news.

headline: Eve of Russia's invasion of Ukraine
detail: Risk-off; ABNB later suspended Russia/Belarus operations. Q4'21 print (Feb 15) had been +3.6%.

headline: Oil spikes above $120 on Russia embargo talk
detail: Travel sold hardest; EXPE -11%.

headline: Oil reverses; travel bounce
detail: Mirror of prior day.

headline: First Fed hike (25 bp) relief rally
detail: Nasdaq +3.7%.

headline: Delta Q1 read-across
detail: Delta reported record bookings; airlines +5-10%; OTAs and ABNB followed.

headline: Q1'22 first-ever profitable Q1 (plus Fed-day rally)
detail: Revenue $1.51B (+70%); nights 102.1M (+59%; first 100M quarter); GBV $17.2B (+67%); adj EBITDA $229M; Q2 guide $2.03-2.13B above est. Nasdaq +3.4% on Powell.

headline: Fed-rally reversal
detail: Nasdaq -5%; gave back the prior day.

headline: Growth-stock capitulation
detail: Nasdaq -4%; ABNB fell below $120 for the first time.

headline: Target/Walmart margin shock
detail: Consumer-discretionary selloff; Nasdaq -4.9%.

headline: Hot May CPI; 75 bp hike priced
detail: S&P 500 enters bear market.

headline: Fed hikes 75 bp
detail: ABNB closes below $100 for the first time.

headline: Oversold bounce
detail: Nasdaq +3.4%; no company news.

headline: Fed 75 bp plus hawkish dots
detail: Travel sold as most rate-sensitive discretionary; ABNB worse than peers on valuation.

headline: Pre-earnings de-risking; bearish sector note on mortgage rates hurting hosts
detail: Day before the Q3'22 print.

headline: Q3'22: beat but Q4 nights guided to moderate
detail: Revenue $2.88B (+29%) at top of guide; adj EBITDA $1.46B (51% margin); nights 99.7M (+25%). Q4 guide: nights growth to slow to ~20%, ADR flat; revenue +17-23%. Fed hiked 75 bp same day.

headline: Cool October CPI (Nov 10) follow-through
detail: Growth rally; no company news.

headline: Powell signals slower hikes
detail: Nasdaq +4.6%.

headline: Q4'22: first profitable full year; Q1 guide beat
detail: Revenue $1.90B (+24%) vs $1.86B; adj EBITDA $506M vs $435M; nights 88.2M (+20%) slightly below 90.1M est; FY22 net income $1.9B and FCF $3.4B. Q1'23 guide $1.75-1.82B vs $1.68B est.

headline: Q1'23: first profitable Q1 on GAAP but nights guided below revenue
detail: Revenue $1.82B (+20%); nights 121.1M (+19%); GBV $20.4B (+19%); net income $117M. Q2 guide $2.35-2.45B (+12-16%) with nights growth below revenue growth; tough pandemic comps.

headline: S&P 500 inclusion (announced Sep 1; effective Sep 18)
detail: Index-buying demand.

headline: Q2'24: shorter lead times and slowing US demand
detail: Revenue $2.75B (+11%); nights 125.1M (+9%); GBV $21.2B (+11%); EPS $0.86 vs $0.92 est; adj EBITDA $894M (33%). Q3 guide $3.67-3.73B and nights growth to moderate; flagged shorter booking lead times.

headline: Q3'24: EPS miss and expense growth
detail: Revenue $3.73B (+10%) beat; nights 122.8M (+8%); GBV $20.1B (+10%); EPS $2.13 vs $2.17; S&M +27.5%, product dev +25%; adj EBITDA margin 52% (-200 bp).

headline: Q4'24: nights beat (best day on record)
detail: Revenue $2.48B (+12%) vs $2.42B; nights 111.0M (+12%) vs 108.7M est; GBV $17.6B (+13%); EPS $0.73 vs $0.58; adj EBITDA $765M vs $654M. Q1 guide $2.23-2.27B below $2.30B est but ignored.

headline: Liberation Day tariffs
detail: 10% baseline tariff; OTAs -5% to -9%; Morningstar cut travel fair values.

headline: 90-day tariff pause
detail: Nasdaq +12%; ABNB in line with peers.

headline: Q2'25: beat but H2 nights to moderate and $200M new-business spend
detail: Revenue $3.10B (+13%) vs $3.04B; nights 134.4M (+7%) vs 133.4M; GBV $23.5B (+11%); EPS $1.03 vs $0.94; adj EBITDA $1.04B (34%). Q3 guide $4.02-4.10B; nights growth to slow into Q4; Services/Experiences to weigh on margin.

headline: AI-disintermediation scare
detail: Wyndham and other hotel chains announced booking deals with Google/Anthropic/ChatGPT; BKNG -9%, EXPE -15%. Booking fell 24% and Expedia 27% in February 2026.

headline: Q2'26: beat on every KPI and FY guide raised
detail: Revenue $3.61B (+17%) vs $3.58B; nights 148.3M (+10%) accelerating; GBV $27.2B (+16%); EPS $1.37 vs $1.26; adj EBITDA $1.26B (35%); first-time bookers +11%; hotels ~3x homes; FY26 revenue at least mid-teens and margin at least 35.5%. Highest close since Apr 2022.
